$schema: Fantasy-writer meta-knowledge extension — adds cross-run learning to the fiction writer agent system
description: Adds a cross-run meta-knowledge system to the fantasy-writer agent pipeline, modeled after the docwriter's proven knowledge-curator → signal-analyzer → knowledge-integrator pattern. Enables the fiction writer to learn from previously written books — discovering what creative approaches worked, what failed in review, what craft decisions improved prose quality, and carrying forward domain-specific insights about its own storytelling tendencies. This is a FUTURE EXTENSION to be applied after the factory produces the base agent family.
assumptions: The fractal factory has already produced the base fantasy-writer agent family (~47 agents, 9 phases)
The base pipeline uses a session orchestrator with pass-based routing (similar to docwriter)
Series architecture from the domain brief is already implemented (series/, book-N/ directory structure)
Adversarial auditors already produce structured findings with severity levels
Beta reading lenses already produce structured per-lens findings
The guide agent already writes story-config.json and launches the pipeline
A bootstrap script exists that creates the working directory structure

designDecisions.decision: Model after docwriter's knowledge-curator + synthesis-coordinator pattern, not a novel design
designDecisions.rationale: The docwriter fractal has a battle-tested meta-knowledge system with proven confidence calibration, quality gates, and cold-start handling. Adapting it to fiction-writing is lower risk than inventing a new pattern.

designDecisions.decision: Meta-knowledge lives in output/meta/ (sibling to series/ and book-N/), not inside series/
designDecisions.rationale: Meta-knowledge is about the writing PROCESS (what approaches worked), not the story CONTENT (what happens in the world). Series knowledge tracks narrative facts; meta-knowledge tracks craft learnings. Mixing them would conflate two different concerns.

designDecisions.decision: Six knowledge categories adapted from docwriter: craft-patterns, craft-anti-patterns, pacing-insights, voice-insights, worldbuilding-insights, run-retrospectives
designDecisions.rationale: These map to the fiction-writer's unique concerns. Docwriter's 'source-observations' (code→doc predictors) becomes 'pacing-insights' (scene-type→prose-quality predictors). Docwriter's 'domain-insights' splits into 'voice-insights' and 'worldbuilding-insights' because fiction has two distinct knowledge domains.

designDecisions.decision: Meta-knowledge synthesis runs as Pass 8.5 (after beta reading, before polish), not after delivery
designDecisions.rationale: Signal extraction depends on reviewer findings (which pass first-attempt? which needed multiple cycles?). It must run before delivery so the knowledge is available for the NEXT run, and after beta reading so it captures the full review picture.

designDecisions.decision: Knowledge curator runs as Pass 0 (before concept development), same as docwriter
designDecisions.rationale: Meta-knowledge from prior runs must be available to all downstream phases. The concept phase especially benefits — if the system learned that certain premise structures consistently produced weak middles, that insight should shape plotting.

designDecisions.decision: Confidence ladder is identical to docwriter: low → medium → high across 1 → 2 → 3+ runs
designDecisions.rationale: The docwriter's ladder is calibrated for LLM signal quality. Fiction writing has similarly noisy signals — a single successful approach could be luck, not a pattern. The strict ladder prevents premature trust.

tasks.title: Extend bootstrap — create meta/ directory tree + seed files
tasks.description: Modify the fantasy-writer bootstrap script to create output/meta/ with subdirectories for each knowledge category: craft-patterns/, craft-anti-patterns/, pacing-insights/, voice-insights/, worldbuilding-insights/, run-retrospectives/. Seed meta/index.json (version 1, empty entries array) and meta/confidence-ladder.md (the calibration rules).
acceptanceCriteria: Bootstrap creates output/meta/ with all 6 subdirectories
Bootstrap creates output/synthesis-signals/
meta/index.json seeded with {version: 1, entries: [], lastSynthesized: null}
confidence-ladder.md documents the low→medium→high promotion rules

tasks.title: Extend progress.json schema — add meta-knowledge pass tracking
tasks.description: Add pass0_knowledgeCuration and pass85_knowledgeSynthesis fields to the progress.json schema so the orchestrator can track meta-knowledge pass completion.
acceptanceCriteria: progress.json includes pass0_knowledgeCuration field (not-started | done)
progress.json includes pass85_knowledgeSynthesis field (not-started | done)
Existing pass fields are unchanged

tasks.title: Create fantasy-writer-knowledge-curator agent
tasks.description: Create the knowledge curator agent (dispatched at Pass 0 before concept development). Reads output/meta/index.json + all knowledge entry files, builds a task profile from story-config.json (genre, tropes, heat level, series position), scores entries by relevance using 4-factor scoring (domain overlap 40%, confidence 25%, recency 20%, usage 15%), and writes a knowledge-brief.json with curated insights grouped by consumer phase. Handles cold-start gracefully (empty brief, not an error). Modeled directly on docwriter-knowledge-curator.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent reads meta/index.json and all referenced knowledge entry files
Builds a task profile from story-config.json (genre, tropes, heat-level, series-position, prior-book-count)
4-factor relevance scoring with ≥0.4 threshold, max 20 entries in brief
Groups entries by primary consumer: concept-agents, worldbuilding-agents, character-agents, plotting-agents, drafting-agents, revision-agents, beta-readers
Cold-start produces valid empty brief with coldStart: true
Detects stale entries (>90 days, <3 usages) and flags for synthesis attention
Writes knowledge-brief.json and own status file

tasks.title: Define knowledge-brief.json schema
tasks.description: Specify the complete JSON schema for the knowledge brief artifact, including task profile, per-category knowledge sections (craft-patterns, craft-anti-patterns, pacing-insights, voice-insights, worldbuilding-insights, run-retro-lessons), stale entries, conflicts, and summary stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema covers: taskProfile, craftPatterns[], craftAntiPatterns[], pacingInsights[], voiceInsights[], worldbuildingInsights[], runRetroLessons[], staleEntries[], conflicts[], summary{}
Each entry in arrays includes: id, title, insight, applicability, invariantsReferenced, confidence, relevanceScore, sourceRun, usageCount, consumers[]
taskProfile includes: genre, tropes, heatLevel, seriesPosition, priorBookCount, historicalSimilarity
summary includes: counts per category, coldStart boolean, truncated boolean, relevanceThreshold

tasks.title: Create fantasy-writer-craft-signal-analyzer agent
tasks.description: Create the craft signal analyzer (dispatched during Pass 8.5 synthesis). Reads per-chapter review artifacts (adversarial auditor findings, beta reader lens reports, revision logs) and extracts three signal types: (A1) craft approaches that passed first-attempt review → candidate craft-patterns, (A2) approaches that required multiple revision cycles → candidate craft-anti-patterns, (A3) pacing decisions that correlated with positive/negative beta reader feedback → candidate pacing-insights. Analog of docwriter-task-signal-analyzer.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads all per-chapter adversarial audit findings, beta reader reports, and revision logs
Signal A1: Identifies chapters passing first-attempt review across all lenses, extracts structural/craft approach used
Signal A2: Identifies chapters needing 2+ revision cycles, identifies root cause of first rejection
Signal A3: Correlates pacing decisions (scene-sequel structure, chapter length, tension placement) with beta-reader pacing audit results
Each signal has strength rating: low (single chapter), medium (2+ chapters same run), confirm-existing (matches existing entry)
Writes synthesis-signals/craft-signals.json

tasks.title: Create fantasy-writer-narrative-signal-analyzer agent
tasks.description: Create the narrative signal analyzer (dispatched during Pass 8.5 synthesis). Reads global pipeline artifacts (worldbuilding consistency findings, character voice audits, romance arc satisfaction scores, series continuity results) and extracts three signal types: (B1) voice patterns that maintained consistency → candidate voice-insights, (B2) worldbuilding approaches that avoided contradictions → candidate worldbuilding-insights, (B3) meta-knowledge brief effectiveness — which curated entries were actually used vs. ignored. Analog of docwriter-context-signal-analyzer.
acceptanceCriteria: Signal B1: Extracts voice patterns from craft-reader lens findings — which POV voice techniques maintained consistency across chapters
Signal B2: Extracts worldbuilding approaches from fantasy-reader lens and adversarial auditor findings — which subcategory decomposition strategies avoided contradictions
Signal B3: Cross-references knowledge-brief.json entries against actual reviewer citations to compute usage rate and effectiveness
Cross-references with craft-signals.json to avoid duplicate signal extraction
Writes synthesis-signals/narrative-signals.json

tasks.title: Create fantasy-writer-knowledge-integrator agent
tasks.description: Create the knowledge integrator (dispatched during Pass 8.5 after both analyzers). Reads both signal files, applies strict confidence ladder (low→medium→high across runs), quality gate (reusability + actionability + non-redundancy), deduplication against existing index, and writes new/updated knowledge entries + run retrospective. This is the ONLY agent that writes to output/meta/. Modeled directly on docwriter-knowledge-integrator.
acceptanceCriteria: Merges and deduplicates signals from both analyzer outputs
Confidence ladder: new signal = low, confirmed in 2+ runs = medium, 3+ runs + >80% acceptance = high. Never auto-promotes to high in same run.
Quality gate: all three criteria (reusability, actionability, non-redundancy) must pass
Writes entries to appropriate meta/ subdirectory with YAML frontmatter (id, title, type, confidence, domains, dates, usageCount, sourceRun, deprecated)
Updates meta/index.json atomically (read-compute-write)
Writes run retrospective to meta/run-retrospectives/<book-id>-<timestamp>.json
Status file reports: newEntries, updatedEntries, discarded, retrospectiveWritten

tasks.title: Define meta-knowledge entry file format
tasks.description: Specify the markdown + YAML frontmatter format for each knowledge entry type: craft-patterns (CP-NNN), craft-anti-patterns (CA-NNN), pacing-insights (PI-NNN), voice-insights (VI-NNN), worldbuilding-insights (WI-NNN). Each entry has: Insight section, Evidence section (citing specific chapters/runs), Applicability section (when to use/avoid).
acceptanceCriteria: Frontmatter fields defined: id, title, type, confidence, domains[], discoveredDate, lastReferencedDate, usageCount, sourceRun, invariantsReferenced[], craftToolsReferenced[], deprecated
Body structure: ## Insight, ## Evidence (citing specific chapters and runs), ## Applicability (when useful, when not)
ID conventions: CP-NNN, CA-NNN, PI-NNN, VI-NNN, WI-NNN
Domains vocabulary defined: concept, worldbuilding, character, plotting, style, drafting, revision, beta-reading

tasks.title: Create fantasy-writer-synthesis-coordinator agent
tasks.description: Create the synthesis coordinator (dispatched at Pass 8.5). Routes the 3 synthesis subagents in sequence: craft-signal-analyzer → narrative-signal-analyzer → knowledge-integrator. Validates each step's output before proceeding. Handles degraded mode (empty signals → integrator still runs). Modeled on docwriter-synthesis-coordinator.
acceptanceCriteria: Dispatches craft-signal-analyzer first, waits for status
Dispatches narrative-signal-analyzer second, waits for status
Dispatches knowledge-integrator third, waits for status
Validates each agent's output files exist and are well-formed
On analyzer failure: logs warning, creates empty signal file, continues in degraded mode
On integrator failure: marks synthesis as failed, writes error status
Reports all subagent results in own status file

tasks.title: Define run retrospective JSON schema
tasks.description: Specify the per-run retrospective format capturing quantified outcomes: total chapters, first-attempt acceptance rate per review lens, total revision cycles, patterns discovered, anti-patterns discovered, knowledge entries created/updated, which craft toolbox items were selected vs. which correlated with quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema includes: bookId, seriesPosition, completedAt, totalChapters, firstAttemptRate (overall + per lens), totalRevisionCycles
Schema includes: craftToolboxSelected[], craftToolboxEffectiveness{} (per tool: applied count, first-attempt rate when applied)
Schema includes: patternsDiscovered, antiPatternsDiscovered, insightsDiscovered, entriesUpdated
Schema includes: knowledgeBriefUtilization (entries briefed, entries cited, entries ignored)

tasks.title: Modify orchestrator — add Pass 0 knowledge curation routing
tasks.description: Add a routing rule to the session orchestrator: before dispatching Pass 1 (concept development), check if pass0_knowledgeCuration is not done. If not, dispatch fantasy-writer-knowledge-curator. After curator completes, set pass0_knowledgeCuration = done and proceed to Pass 1.
acceptanceCriteria: Orchestrator checks pass0_knowledgeCuration before entering Pass 1
Dispatches knowledge-curator when pass0 is not done
Reads curator status file and validates knowledge-brief.json exists
Sets pass0_knowledgeCuration = done before proceeding
Pass 1+ phases proceed unchanged if pass0 already done (re-entry safe)

tasks.title: Modify orchestrator — add Pass 8.5 synthesis routing
tasks.description: Add a routing rule: after Pass 8 (beta reading) converges and before Pass 9 (polish/delivery), check if pass85_knowledgeSynthesis is not done. If not, dispatch fantasy-writer-synthesis-coordinator. After synthesis completes, set pass85_knowledgeSynthesis = done and proceed to Pass 9.
acceptanceCriteria: Orchestrator checks pass85_knowledgeSynthesis after pass8 (beta reading) is done
Dispatches synthesis-coordinator when pass85 is not done
Reads coordinator status file and validates meta/index.json was updated
Sets pass85_knowledgeSynthesis = done before proceeding to pass9 (polish)
Pass 9 proceeds unchanged if pass85 already done (re-entry safe)

tasks.title: Update orchestrator agents list and architecture diagram
tasks.description: Add the 4 new direct-dispatch agents to the orchestrator's agents list and update the ASCII architecture diagram to show Pass 0 and Pass 8.5 positions in the pipeline.
acceptanceCriteria: agents[] frontmatter includes knowledge-curator and synthesis-coordinator
Architecture diagram shows Pass 0 before concept, Pass 8.5 between beta-reading and polish
Diagram shows synthesis-coordinator's 3 subagents (craft-signal-analyzer, narrative-signal-analyzer, knowledge-integrator)

tasks.title: Modify concept phase agents — consume knowledge brief
tasks.description: Update the concept development agents (idea distillation, theme extraction, craft toolbox selector) to read knowledge-brief.json if it exists. Specifically: the craft toolbox selector should check if prior runs discovered that certain tools correlated with high first-attempt acceptance for similar story types. Concept-level agents should check for anti-patterns that suggest certain premise structures led to weak middles or unsatisfying arcs.
acceptanceCriteria: Agents read knowledge-brief.json if it exists, skip gracefully if absent
Craft toolbox selector considers craftPatterns entries when selecting tools for the new story
Concept agents check craftAntiPatterns entries for premise-level warnings
Agents note which brief entries they consulted in their status files (for B3 effectiveness tracking)

tasks.title: Modify worldbuilding phase agents — consume knowledge brief
tasks.description: Update worldbuilding agents to read knowledge-brief.json's worldbuildingInsights section. If prior runs discovered that certain subcategory decomposition strategies avoided contradictions, or that magic system documentation approaches prevented downstream continuity issues, apply those insights.
acceptanceCriteria: Agents read knowledge-brief.json worldbuildingInsights if available
Worldbuilding agents apply insights about subcategory organization that reduced contradictions
Magic system agent applies insights about documentation approaches that prevented downstream continuity failures
Agents note which brief entries they consulted in their status files

tasks.title: Modify drafting phase agents — consume knowledge brief
tasks.description: Update chapter drafting agents to read knowledge-brief.json's craftPatterns and pacingInsights sections. If prior runs discovered that certain scene-sequel structures, chapter length targets, or tension placement strategies correlated with first-attempt review acceptance, apply those insights during drafting.
acceptanceCriteria: Chapter drafter reads craftPatterns and pacingInsights from brief
Drafter considers insights about scene structures that correlated with quality
Drafter considers insights about pacing patterns that received positive beta-reader feedback
Agents note which brief entries they consulted in their status files

tasks.title: Modify revision and beta-reader agents — consume knowledge brief
tasks.description: Update revision and beta-reader agents to read knowledge-brief.json's craftAntiPatterns section. If prior runs discovered recurring failure modes (e.g., 'dialogue tags overused in romantic scenes', 'magic system costs forgotten in action climaxes'), beta readers should specifically look for those patterns. This gives reviewers institutional memory.
acceptanceCriteria: Revision agents read craftAntiPatterns from brief and add them to their review checklist
Beta reader lenses read relevant insight categories and use them to calibrate sensitivity
Craft reader lens specifically checks for anti-patterns from prior runs
All consuming agents note which brief entries they consulted

tasks.title: Modify guide agent — detect existing meta/ state and report lineage
tasks.description: Update the guide agent to check if output/meta/index.json exists and has entries. If so, report to the user: 'Found knowledge from N prior runs (X patterns, Y anti-patterns, Z insights). This will be used to guide the new story.' This gives the user visibility into the learning state.
acceptanceCriteria: Guide checks for output/meta/index.json on startup
If present with entries: reports count of entries by type, count of prior runs (from retrospectives), highest-confidence entries
If absent or empty: reports 'First run — no prior knowledge available. Meta-knowledge will be collected after this run completes.'
Report is informational only — does not block or alter the user interaction flow

tasks.title: Verify cold-start path — first run produces valid empty brief + populates meta/
tasks.description: End-to-end verification that the first run (no prior meta-knowledge) works correctly: curator produces a valid empty brief, all consuming agents gracefully skip brief consultation, synthesis extracts signals and writes initial entries, retrospective is written, index is populated.
acceptanceCriteria: Curator writes knowledge-brief.json with coldStart: true, all sections empty
No downstream agent errors when brief sections are empty arrays
Synthesis runs after beta reading — both analyzers produce signals
Integrator writes at least 1 knowledge entry (there should always be SOMETHING learned)
Retrospective file is created in meta/run-retrospectives/
meta/index.json has entries > 0 after first run completes

tasks.title: Verify sequel path — second run consumes prior meta-knowledge
tasks.description: End-to-end verification that the second run (with prior meta-knowledge from run 1) works correctly: curator produces a non-empty brief with relevant entries, consuming agents cite entries from the brief, synthesis detects confirmed patterns and promotes confidence levels, retrospective reports knowledge utilization stats.
acceptanceCriteria: Curator writes knowledge-brief.json with coldStart: false, at least one non-empty section
At least one consuming agent cites a brief entry in its status file
Integrator promotes at least one entry from low→medium (confirmed in 2nd run)
Retrospective reports knowledgeBriefUtilization with entries > 0
No duplicate entries in meta/index.json
Total entries in index is higher than after run 1

tasks.title: Verify confidence ladder enforcement across runs
tasks.description: Verify that the strict confidence ladder is enforced: run 1 entries start at low, run 2 confirmation promotes to medium, run 3+ confirmation with >80% acceptance promotes to high. No entry ever jumps levels. Violated entries (approach was used but reviewer rejected) are demoted.
acceptanceCriteria: No entry has confidence: 'high' with fewer than 3 sourceRuns
No entry has confidence: 'medium' with fewer than 2 sourceRuns
All new entries from a single run have confidence: 'low'
Violated entries are demoted (confidence decreased, demotion note present)
Confidence promotions are logged in the integrator status file

tasks.title: Verify meta-knowledge vs. series-knowledge separation
tasks.description: Verify that meta-knowledge (output/meta/) and series knowledge (output/series/) remain cleanly separated. Meta-knowledge tracks process insights (craft approaches, pacing strategies). Series knowledge tracks narrative facts (world state, character positions, plot threads). No agent writes to both.
acceptanceCriteria: knowledge-integrator ONLY writes to output/meta/ — never touches series/
Series knowledge agents ONLY write to output/series/ — never touch meta/
Meta-knowledge entries reference craft approaches, not narrative content
Series knowledge entries reference story facts, not process techniques
No entry in meta/index.json contains story-specific content (character names, plot points)

tasks.title: Update domain-brief.md — add Cross-Run Meta-Knowledge section
tasks.description: Add a new section to the domain brief documenting the meta-knowledge system as a designed architectural feature. This ensures the factory understands the pattern when producing agents. Describes: the meta/ directory purpose, the Pass 0 / Pass 8.5 lifecycle, the confidence ladder, the knowledge categories, and the separation from series knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: New section 'Cross-Run Meta-Knowledge System' added after 'Series Architecture & Sequel Production'
Describes: purpose (learn from prior runs), location (output/meta/), lifecycle (Pass 0 curation → Pass 8.5 synthesis)
Documents 6 knowledge categories with domain vocabulary
Documents confidence ladder (low→medium→high) and quality gate (reusability, actionability, non-redundancy)
Explicitly distinguishes meta-knowledge (process insights) from series knowledge (narrative facts)
References the docwriter pattern as the architectural precedent

steps.note: Foundation — bootstrap directory structure and seed files
Schemas/specs — all independent, define contracts before agents
Integrator depends on both analyzers' output contract
Synthesis coordinator depends on all 3 subagents
Orchestrator routing (Pass 0 and Pass 8.5 are independent additions)
Orchestrator diagram update depends on both routing rules
Consumer modifications — all independent (concept, world, drafting, revision agents)
Domain brief update — can be done before verification
Cold-start verification — validates first-run path end-to-end
Confidence ladder verification — needs multiple runs to validate
